text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the Student 
Council-sponsored 
Tracsen Academy Calligraphy Contest has 
come to an end! 
Thank you all for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Tough break, "Madam Vice President." 
Having to do clean-up duty and all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't call me by that title.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, apologies. Still, it's hard to 
believe. 
To think that Brian, who always preferred 
lingering 
in the shadows... is now a member of the 
student council.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Brian!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Bring over a whole stack of newspapers, 
will you? 
We need to soak up the leftover ink from 
the brushes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'd also like to see how much ink is left. 
Could you gather all the inkwells in one 
place?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Don't scowl like that. I'll help too. 
We are cousins, after all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Still, when you joined the student 
council... 
I wondered if they had some sort of dirt 
on you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Shut up. Just hand over those brushes.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't be so angry. 
You don't entirely hate student council 
work 
yourself, do you?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide always looked after you as her 
sister, 
and took great care of me as her cousin, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Following in your sister's footsteps, 
perhaps 
it's only natural that you grew into 
someone 
who instinctively looks after those under 
you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't twist this. The reason I joined 
the student council... has nothing to do 
with that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SLAP!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sudden loud slam causes a commotion 
among the girls. 
Everyone turns their gaze toward 
the Student Council Vice President, Narita 
Brian.
choice_data_list:
What was that sound? Did something 
happen...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm writing a duel challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—The reason I joined the student council 
was without question to "compete."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You ought to know it too. 
The ferocity of the one sitting in the 
president's chair.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What she does can hardly even be called 
running anymore. 
...It's a "hunt."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't simply pursue raw speed for 
its own sake; 
her run exists only because there's an 
opponent to face. 
————A run meant solely to "bring down the 
opponent."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Treating everyone running ahead as prey, 
catching them all and grinding them down. 
Even while harboring such savage 
instincts, she—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —refuses to strip away her mask of reason.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
『My, Brian. Are you finally willing 
to accept the position of Vice 
President?』

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
『That would be an immense help. 
I have never seen an horsegirl who 
stimulates 
the primal instincts of her kind quite 
like you.』

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
『...—After all, being by your side 
might just draw mine out as well.』

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That day, she distinctly said it: 
"Someday, I will accept your challenge."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's why I keep slamming challenges at 
her. 
To race that thing, and satisfy my hunger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Right by her side, so she has nowhere to 
run.
choice_data_list:
Rudolf sounds pretty savage through your 
eyes.

Rudolf seems quite ferocious through your 
eyes.

...I'm looking forward to the day of that 
showdown.

...I can't wait to see that showdown 
unfold.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Right by her side, so she has nowhere to 
run.
choice_data_list:
Rudolf sounds pretty savage through your 
eyes.

Rudolf seems quite ferocious through your 
eyes.

...I'm looking forward to the day of that 
showdown.

...I can't wait to see that showdown 
unfold.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, a starving beast. 
Because I "saw" it myself that day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
When she told me she'd accept my 
challenge, 
her eyes were—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—smiling. 
As if daring me, "Try it if you can."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Yet, is that truly all 
you're hoping for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yet she always keeps me on hold. 
Only teasing my hunger further.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
『—Tell me, Brian. 
When an horsegirl is drawn in by your 
soul, 
how fiercely will she blaze?』

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
『What kind of expression do you imagine 
on the face of the horsegirl waiting for 
you in the future?』

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Yet, is that truly all 
you're hoping for?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Your desire and your thirst run deep.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And the longer you stay in one place, 
the stronger that craving grows. ...It has 
always been that way.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: What are you thinking right now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President. 
Thank you for overseeing today's 
calligraphy contest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, thank you both for your hard work. 
Hehe, even so—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today's report is a "duel challenge," is 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...President. 
Do you intend to race Brian?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Give a monster what it desires, and 
it may well 
spread its wings and take flight into the 
distant horizon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yet my ideals require her presence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that challenge is Brian's 
"report," 
is it not?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then let us store it away in the box once 
more. 
...Safely at the very bottom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the calligraphy contest, 
I find myself remembering as I look out 
over the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What ever happened to that race between 
Narita Brian 
and Symboli Rudolf? At the very least, up 
until today, 
I haven't heard any whispers of it.
